name: supergamer1337/plesk-oidc
description: Plesk extension for admin login through an OIDC provider

up: timeout 120 sh -c 'until docker compose exec -T plesk curl -fs -o /dev/null http://localhost:${IDP_PORT:-8080}/default/.well-known/openid-configuration; do sleep 2; done'
deploy: docker compose exec -T plesk plesk bin extension --upgrade /tmp/plesk-oidc.zip
scripts.login: link=$(docker compose exec -T plesk plesk login admin | head -n1) && echo "https://localhost:${PLESK_PORT:-8443}/login?secret=${link#*secret=}"

scripts-descriptions.up: Start Plesk and the mock OIDC provider
scripts-descriptions.deploy: Install or upgrade src/ as an extension in the running Plesk
scripts-descriptions.login: Print a one time admin login URL for the panel
